mapper.update: UPDATE sw_im_bot_message SET process_state=CASE WHEN process_state='CANCEL_REQUESTED' AND #{row.processState} IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED','CANCELED') THEN 'CANCELED' WHEN process_state='CANCEL_REQUESTED' THEN process_state ELSE #{row.processState} END, send_state=CASE WHEN send_state='CANCELED' OR process_state='CANCELED' THEN 'CANCELED' WHEN send_state='SENDING' AND (#{row.sendState} IS NULL OR #{row.sendState}='PENDING') THEN 'SENDING' WHEN send_state='PENDING' AND #{row.sendState} IS NULL THEN 'PENDING' ELSE #{row.sendState} END, reply_content=#{row.replyContent},session_id=#{row.sessionId},db_message_id=#{row.dbMessageId},run_id=#{row.runId}, last_seq=GREATEST(last_seq,COALESCE(#{row.lastSeq},0)),last_error=#{row.lastError},provider_message_id=COALESCE(provider_message_id,#{row.providerMessageId}), processing_owner_version=#{version},update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{row.id} AND AND (process_state IS NULL OR process_state NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED','CANCELED') OR process_state=#{row.processState}) AND (send_state IS NULL OR send_state NOT IN ('ACCEPTED','FAILED','UNKNOWN') OR send_state=#{row.sendState})

UPDATE sw_im_bot_message SET process_state=CASE WHEN process_state='CANCEL_REQUESTED' THEN process_state ELSE #{row.processState} END, db_message_id=COALESCE(#{row.dbMessageId},db_message_id),run_id=COALESCE(#{row.runId},run_id), last_seq=GREATEST(last_seq,COALESCE(#{row.lastSeq},0)),processing_owner_version=#{version},update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{row.id} AND AND process_state NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED','CANCELED') AND last_seq <= COALESCE(#{row.lastSeq},0)

UPDATE sw_im_bot_message answer INNER JOIN sw_im_bot_message source ON source.id=#{sourceId} INNER JOIN sw_im_bot b ON b.id=source.bot_id SET answer.process_state='SUCCEEDED',answer.db_message_id=source.db_message_id,answer.run_id=source.run_id, answer.reply_context=JSON_SET(COALESCE(answer.reply_context,'{}'),'$.answerTo',CAST(source.id AS CHAR)), answer.processing_owner_version=#{version},answer.update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE answer.id=#{id} AND answer.direction='INBOUND' AND answer.content_type='TEXT' AND answer.process_state='QUEUED' AND source.process_state='WAITING_INPUT' AND answer.id > source.id AND answer.bot_id=source.bot_id AND answer.tenant_id=source.tenant_id AND answer.user_id=source.user_id AND answer.target_session_id=source.target_session_id AND b.owner_node=#{node} AND b.owner_version=#{version} AND b.lease_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AND b.enabled=1 AND b.auto_process_enabled=1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sw_im_bot_user u WHERE (u.bot_id=b.id OR (u.id=b.id AND u.bot_id=b.parent_bot_id)) AND u.tenant_id=answer.tenant_id AND u.user_id=answer.user_id AND u.authorized=1 AND u.external_user_key IS NOT NULL)

UPDATE sw_im_bot_message SET file_id=#{fileId},content=#{name},reply_context=#{context}, processing_owner_version=#{version},update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{id} AND direction='INBOUND' AND content_type='FILE' AND file_id IS NULL AND process_state='QUEUED' AND AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sw_im_bot b WHERE b.id=sw_im_bot_message.bot_id AND b.enabled=1 AND b.auto_process_enabled=1) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sw_im_bot_user u WHERE (u.bot_id=sw_im_bot_message.bot_id OR u.id=sw_im_bot_message.bot_id) AND u.user_id=sw_im_bot_message.user_id AND u.tenant_id=sw_im_bot_message.tenant_id AND u.authorized=1 AND u.external_user_key IS NOT NULL)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sw_im_bot_message (id,bot_id,tenant_id,user_id,target_session_id,direction,content_type,file_id,content, external_message_id,reply_context,provider_uuid,request_id,request_hash,send_state,session_id,db_message_id,run_id,expires_at,processing_owner_version) SELECT #{row.id},s.bot_id,s.tenant_id,s.user_id,s.target_session_id,'OUTBOUND',#{row.contentType},#{row.fileId},#{row.content}, s.external_message_id,#{row.replyContext},#{row.providerUuid},#{row.requestId},#{row.requestHash},'PENDING',s.session_id,s.db_message_id,s.run_id,s.expires_at,#{version} FROM sw_im_bot_message s INNER JOIN sw_im_bot b ON b.id=s.bot_id WHERE s.id=#{sourceId} AND s.process_state='SUCCEEDED' AND b.owner_node=#{node} AND b.owner_version=#{version} AND b.lease_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AND b.enabled=1 ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=sw_im_bot_message.id
